scope.independence: This is an independent Polymarket model-development lane. Binance public BTCUSDT observations are optional read-only exogenous features only. Binance credentials, accounts, orders, balances, positions, capital, PnL, risk state, and execution authority are forbidden.

source_contract.binance_availability_rule: A completed second becomes available only at second_ms plus 1000 milliseconds.

target_contract.label: Up when official terminal CLOB and Gamma evidence both identify the Up token as the unique winner; Down when both identify Down.
target_contract.future_target_access: Targets are stored separately and may be joined only after the feature rows and their hashes are materialized.
target_contract.first_party_crypto_price_limit: The first-party historical Chainlink endpoint reports a 30-day maximum and therefore cannot label these historical dates.

binance_features: spot and perpetual signed aggressive quote share
spot and perpetual maximum aggregate quote
polymarket_features: latest historical Up-token price at or before the decision
age of the latest historical price observation
price change from the first in-event observation
causal_feature_contract.historical_price_limit: The official endpoint is minute-fidelity and trade-price based. It is an informational control, not an executable quote, spread, depth, fill, or latency observation.

partition.insufficient_power: Reject or extend under a new preregistered contract. Never relax gates after test access.

candidate_contract.search: A fixed bounded regularization and tree-complexity grid only. No test-driven changes.
candidate_contract.ai: No language model is screened on this historical lane because reproducible point-in-time text inputs do not exist. AI remains veto-or-reduce only in the prospective lane.

resource_contract.network: Use bounded retries, Retry-After, request-size limits, cursor checkpoints, and no authenticated endpoint.
resource_contract.rate: At most five requests per second per public origin with no burst above five.
resource_contract.storage: Store canonical source payloads and hashes once, store compact derived rows, and never duplicate local Binance raw data.
resource_contract.memory: Stream one UTC day at a time; no full-history raw payload accumulation.
resource_contract.database: Use one compact DuckDB historical-screen database with explicit transactions, append-safe checkpoints, and zstd-compressible canonical JSON.
resource_contract.ssd: Disable unnecessary raw archive retention, avoid temporary materializations, and checkpoint only after durable batches.
